purpose: Teach: カキコ/小中学校/新米/百姓/貧乏人/里山/駿/ぎょ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様にネットのカキコを注意されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's grandson was giving her a hard time about something he posted online.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Settle into the observation gently. Slight lean forward, like sharing something she noticed and wants Aoi to know.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様が小中学校時代の写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And her kids showed me photos from when they were in elementary and middle school.
lines.style: Gentle smile in the voice. A small, genuine warmth — the kind of detail that stuck with her. Unhurried, like she's picturing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自身を「経営の新米です」って謙遜されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She called herself a novice at managing the shop, you know. So humble about it.
lines.style: Soft, admiring tone. Slight shake of the head — affectionate exasperation at false modesty. Grounded, not performative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご先祖の百姓の生活誌を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she told me about her ancestors' farming life. Really opened up about where she comes from.
lines.style: Attentive, present. Let the weight of what she shared land naturally. Not rushed. Respectful pause before moving on.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、若い頃は「貧乏人だった」って苦労話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She talked about being poor when she was young. Real hardship stories.
lines.style: Quieter now. Honor the vulnerability in what was shared. Deliberate pace. Voice steady and sincere, not pitying.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、里山の保全活動をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's doing conservation work in the satoyama — the borderland forests. That's beautiful.
lines.style: Brightness returns, but grounded. Genuine admiration. Slow enough to let the significance register. Not gushing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の駿くんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She brought her grandson Shun in with her last time.
lines.style: Simple, direct. A quiet smile. The kind of detail that shows Aoi notices and cares about people's lives.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、注文ミスに「ぎょっと」されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But when I messed up her order, she looked so startled. It was kind of funny.
lines.style: Wry, genuine laugh underneath. Not cruel — delighted by the human moment. Self-aware. Light, brief, unforced.
